title: WheelDeck mapping message
description: Mapping-mode switch sent by the phone. The desktop applies it to InputMapper.Mode for the session; the desktop restarts in keyboard mode. The optional preset scopes the binding tables per layout preset (REQ-018).

mode.description: keyboard: simulated key presses. gamepad: virtual-controller buttons with keyboard fallback for controls the button table leaves None.

preset.description: Active layout preset name (e.g. Sequential). Omitted or empty keeps the current preset.
